clause.quote: A Stream parser MUST be able to use the Version String to extract and deserialize (deterministically) any serialized Stream field maps.

assertions.note: inferred consumer obligation: line 1129 requires a parser to extract a field map by its version string but does not state what it does with a short one; also relies on the harness end-of-input rule; informative class: truncated

description: A KERI 2.0 inception with the last five bytes of the stream removed, so the body is shorter than the size its version string declares. The adapter protocol makes the end of the input final (a harness rule, not a specification claim), so a parser may not wait for more bytes. The specification has no sentence saying such a stream must be rejected; the assertion rests on the cited MUST, which this stream violates.
title: Reject a body shorter than its version string declares
